title: SpaceCast-Bench: Evaluating Predictive Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
abstract: Existing spatial reasoning benchmarks mainly test spatial perception: reading off relations already visible in the input. Yet real-world spatial intelligence demands predictive spatial reasoning: constructing a scene from observations, anticipating how an intervention changes it, and reasoning about the unseen outcome. We introduce SpaceCast-Bench, the first benchmark to directly and diagnostically evaluate this capability. Built around an observe-transform-infer framework, its 3,862 questions from 182 real-world scenes span 16 task types at three levels: static perception, local prediction, and global prediction, progressively requiring scene understanding, spatial state updating, and relational inference over unobserved outcomes. Evaluating 21 models exposes a stark gap: the strongest model reaches only 58.0% against 87.2% human performance, while spatially specialized models remain near random chance. Controlled analyses further reveal that bridge views are critical for integrating distributed observations, and that explicit 3D evidence benefits models more reliably than generated outcome images or videos. Fine-tuning on our programmatically generated data lifts Qwen3-VL-4B from 34.0% to 65.7% with macro-average gains across six out-of-domain benchmarks.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2610.12402v1 的 24 页全文与关键图表核验整理。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。
analysis.ideaZh: SpaceCast把空间理解拆成observe–transform–infer，以depth-verifiedviewchains和mesh/attachmentgraph程序改scene并标未见结果。价值不止benchmark：作者用54disjointscenes的12249Q训练Qwen4B，从34.0→65.7%macro，并把六OODmacro33.5→38.1%；MindCube仍下降。值得借鉴可操纵scene-state监督，但不是物理dynamics，train/benchmark只有室内。
analysis.motivationZh: 不少空间 benchmark 只要求识别当前可见关系，难以检验模型能否推断视点移动、物体变换或连接变化后的状态。需要把当前观察与未直接展示的空间后果分开，测量真正的 predictive spatial reasoning。
analysis.methodZh: eval3862questions/182ScanNet与ScanNet++validation scenes，16tasks覆盖camera/object/worldframes、distance/visibility/attachment。13crossviewtasks选择互不展示对方queryobjects的anchors，再以depthverifiedcorridorbridge连接；三task单view。局部translate/orbit/remove随attachmentdescendants操作，globalyaw保持camera固定，relationengine重新raycast/算distance/direction并过滤边界、invalidendpoint。10annotators双盲revieweachquestion，另12volunteers做人类baseline。另scene-disjointprogrammatictrainpool用rank32LoRA和alignerSFT/stagedreplay，验证预测空间能力可训练且有选择性transfer。
methodFlow: 选target-disjointanchorviews，以sensor-depth验证的corridoroverlap搜索最多六bridgeviews，只给pre-interventionimages。
在meshsceneprogrammatically施加local/rigidyawtransform，重新计算reference-frame方向、surface距离、raycastvisibility与attachmentlabels。
analysis.experimentsZh: ScanNet134scenes718Q、ScanNet++48scenes3144Q；L1/L2/L3=1368/1709/785，overall为16taskmacro。21modelsdeterministicCoT，12humanvolunteersmacro87.2%（3340/3862micro不同），10annotators独立双审。Qwen3VL4B训练12249unique/24576exposures，SFTLoRA32+aligner，GRPOLoRA16/8completions。 以下结果为作者报告：作者报告Qwenbase34.0→mixed64.8/staged65.7；stagedlocal54.0、global70.8；GRPO37.7远低于SFT。（Table4, PDF p.9）；作者报告stagedOODDSI47.4vs37.3、SPARTQA34.8vs28.8、VSI45.3vs40.7；MindCube30.8vs31.2。（Table4 PDF p.9; subsetcountsTable10 p.21） 对照范围：21proprietary/general/spatialmodels，directvsCoT、bridgeablation、BEV/GT3Dmetadata与generatedendpoints。OOD固定slicesMMSI274/SPARTQA250/MindCube292/CLEVRER600/VSI150/DSI1769，不是六benchmark完整scores；仅一Qwenbackbonetraining、未给seedCI/其他training-sizecontrol。 消融与诊断：stagedvsmixed进步在Local而mixedGlobal更高；GRPOtransferprofile不同。3Dmetadata给privileged信息、generatedendpoints含错误，不能据它们直接断言所有worldmodels无法spatialreason。观察质量与relationengine设计仍影响benchmark。
analysis.insightZh: 将可验证3Dtransformation与view-chain证据结合到未观察结果推理，并以scene-disjoint训练验证transfer；主要技术增量是geometry-groundeddata/capabilitysupervision，而不是新的VLMarchitecture或physicalworldmodel。
analysis.evidenceZh: depthverifiedbridgecorridor连接disjointanchors，poststate不显示给model。（Sec.3.2 Fig.2 PDF pp.3–5; App.B.3 pp.15–16）；12249uniqueQ来自54scene，与182evalscenesID不重叠；stagedSFT65.7%vsbase34.0%。（App.B.1 PDF p.14; Sec.4.4/Table4 p.9; App.C.4 p.20）；作者报告六OODmacro38.1%vs33.5%，但MindCube30.8%vs31.2%。（Table4 PDF p.9; App.C.5/Table10 pp.20–21）；interventions没有simulatefriction/deformation/collision-drivenmotion，allindoors。（App.A Limitations, PDF p.14）
analysis.caveatZh: 室内182scenes、ScanNet++占多数，未覆盖outdoor/otherobjectscales（p.14）。；mesh/depth/instanceerrors可污染contact/occlusionlabels，即使humanreview不能完全消除（p.14）。；只programmaticrigidinterventions，不评物理dynamics（p.14）。；模板熟悉/有限reference-frames可贡献ID提升，需要更自由language/动作/generalobject验证。；singletrainedbackbone和selectedOODslices/无multiseedstats限制宏泛化结论。；attachmentgraph是一parent支持/接触heuristic，不等于真实rigid连接或manufacturability。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: predictiveposition/attachment/state-updates与SVG/3Dscene设计操作、assetassemblyfeedback能力有直接迁移思路；不能写已在LEGO/CAD验证。
